title: Private bounded PowerShell containment qualification
objective: Qualify the first bounded Windows PowerShell execution path inside the already-proven Cotra containment boundary before any public powershell.run authority is exposed. The qualification must use the inbox Windows PowerShell executable with a fixed provider-private script, explicit NoProfile/NonInteractive semantics, sanitized environment, NUL stdin, zero network capabilities, bounded stdout/stderr and timeout, Job lifecycle accounting, verified termination, and protected-state isolation.

include: provider-private native Windows PowerShell qualification mode
exact inbox Windows PowerShell executable path under System32 WindowsPowerShell v1.0
existing sanitized execution environment with Cotra/tunnel secret exclusion
AppContainer suspended launch and token verification
Job assignment and membership verification before resume
verified zero active Job processes before destructive classifications
post-primary-exit descendant-aware pipe lifecycle from SG-000011
protected-state and authority-channel isolation regressions from SG-000012
native Windows success timeout and output-limit qualification
exclude: approval bypass or persistent approval reuse

acceptance.claim: Native Windows exact-head tests launch the exact inbox Windows PowerShell executable through a provider-private fixed-script mode using NoLogo, NoProfile, NonInteractive, trusted-workspace cwd, sanitized environment, NUL stdin, and zero network capabilities.

The fixed PowerShell fixture completes successfully with bounded stdout/stderr, expected deterministic output, AppContainer identity verified, pre-resume Job membership verified, and final zero-active-process Job quiescence.

Timeout and stdout/stderr output-limit PowerShell qualification paths preserve typed ProcessTimeout, OutputLimit, and TerminationUnverified semantics and prove verified process-tree termination before destructive classifications.

Tests prove profile loading is disabled, stdin is NUL/EOF, caller environment/script/executable overrides are unavailable, PowerShell remoting/network capability is absent, and Cotra/tunnel/API secret-like variables are not inherited.
SG-000011 descendant-aware post-exit pipe lifecycle remains bounded for the PowerShell qualification path and SG-000012 protected-state/authority-channel isolation remains green.
No public powershell.run or additional process.spawn executable authority is registered by this grain; policy, cotrad, and MCP continue to deny PowerShell authority.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

done_when: The provider-private bounded PowerShell containment path is merged with exact-head and post-merge verification on native Windows, the existing process and protected-state boundaries remain green, and no public PowerShell authority has been introduced.
